clusters.name: Ground-up self-storage development
clusters.description: Build new self-storage facilities with investor and bank capital, then own them and collect unit rent.

clusters.name: Self-storage facility ownership
clusters.description: Buy or own and operate self-storage facilities, earning monthly rent from people and businesses storing belongings.

clusters.name: Storage yard on leased or optioned land
clusters.description: Run outdoor or portable storage yards on land secured by lease, option or partnership, or on land held for appreciation, earning storage rents.

clusters.name: Triple-net commercial property ownership
clusters.description: Buy small commercial properties such as gas stations and strip malls and lease them to operators or tenants for rental income.

clusters.name: Monetizing land rights
clusters.description: Landowners earn income from cell tower ground leases, utility easements and mineral rights under their land.

clusters.name: Digital billboard ownership
clusters.description: Own a digital billboard and sell rotating ad slots to local businesses.

clusters.name: Long-term residential rental properties
clusters.description: Buy single-family homes, often with leverage or refinancing, and rent them to long-term tenants.

clusters.name: Build-to-rent and refinance
clusters.description: Build residential homes, refinance them to recover capital and keep them as rentals.

clusters.name: Apartment and multifamily investing
clusters.description: Buy apartment buildings, including value-add deals and small-town roll-ups, for rental income and an eventual portfolio sale.

clusters.name: Short-term rental properties
clusters.description: Acquire distinctive properties such as custom homes, islands or lighthouses and rent them nightly on Airbnb-style platforms.

clusters.name: Airbnb property management
clusters.description: Manage short-term rentals for property owners for a fee.

clusters.name: Tiny home rentals
clusters.description: Place tiny homes or converted sheds on rural land and rent them monthly to tenants who want cheap housing.

clusters.name: Mobile home and RV park investing
clusters.description: Acquire mobile home and RV parks, often small and lightly staffed, and earn lot rent.

clusters.name: Estate sales as a house-flip deal funnel
clusters.description: Run estate sales to get early access to houses, then buy, flip or wholesale them below market value.

clusters.name: Automated FSBO lowball offers
clusters.description: Scrape Zillow for-sale-by-owner listings and bulk-text low cash offers to source homes to flip or wholesale.

clusters.name: House wholesaling
clusters.description: Put a house under contract and assign the contract to an investor for a fee.

clusters.name: House flipping
clusters.description: Buy and renovate homes, then resell them at a profit.

clusters.name: iBuyer-style scaled home buying
clusters.description: Use pricing models to buy homes below market value and resell them at a modest markup at scale.

clusters.name: Vacant land wholesaling to builders
clusters.description: Contract vacant land below a builder's buy box and assign the contract to the builder for a spread.

clusters.name: Land flipping and subdivision
clusters.description: Buy land parcels, add value through subdivision or features such as mature hardwood trees, and resell for a profit.

clusters.name: Land plus used mobile home resale
clusters.description: Buy a parcel, install a used mobile home and sell the combined property to a buyer who wants a place to live.

clusters.name: Land banking and speculation
clusters.description: Buy land, for example near announced developments such as Buc-ee's sites, and hold it for appreciation.

clusters.name: USDA farm loan land acquisition
clusters.description: Qualify as a beginning farmer and use 0%-down USDA loans to buy land and buildings.

clusters.name: Spec and teardown home development
clusters.description: Build new homes on lots or on teardown sites, including luxury builds, for resale to home buyers.

clusters.name: Farmland ownership with agricultural operations
clusters.description: Own farmland and water rights while running cattle or almond operations that cover costs as the land appreciates.

clusters.name: Commercial real estate brokerage
clusters.description: Find tenants or deals for commercial and industrial properties, using personalized outreach, and earn commission.

clusters.name: Residential realtor services
clusters.description: Work as a residential real estate agent and win listings through prospecting and ads, earning sales commission.

clusters.name: Laundromat location scouting
clusters.description: Map laundromats and gap areas to find acquisition targets for a multi-store laundromat portfolio.

clusters.name: Housing-related services
clusters.description: Offer broad services tied to housing needs; no revenue model is stated.

clusters.name: Reclaimed building materials and modular building resale
clusters.description: Buy flooring, containers and modular offices at auction and resell or rent them to remodelers and flippers.
